title: Essential: k value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the friction proportionality constant k = 0.1.

title: Essential: L value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the uphill distance L = 67/185 m (or decimal equivalent ≈ 0.362 m).

title: Important: Motor power balance
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply energy conservation to the motor, relating electrical power (UI), resistive loss (I²R), and mechanical power (T₁v) to find the rope tension T₁.

title: Important: Incline angle from equilibrium
description: Important Criteria: The student must analyze the uniform motion condition to set up force balances for the trolley and counterweight, solving for sinθ = 0.5.

title: Important: Post-motor acceleration
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law to the trolley-counterweight system after the motor is off to find the deceleration a.

title: Optional: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates dimensional analysis or unit verification for key equations (e.g., power, force, acceleration).

title: Pitfall: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize sign errors in the force balance (e.g., wrong direction for friction, tension, or gravity components on the incline).

title: Pitfall: Misapplied power equation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize incorrectly relating motor power (e.g., omitting I²R loss or misidentifying mechanical power term).
